title: Network meta-analysis in the browser: a tool validated against the R package netmeta
description: Validation archive v1.1.0 for the allmeta NMA app, copied byte-for-byte from allmeta v1.8.0 (release commit 1cb3f8409c7af75ed41f7e1811f9c502f900fc79; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23515177). Updates the app and runtime assets, including PR #164 refusal of malformed contrasts rather than fitting a partial network. The original netmeta 3.7-0 benchmark, corpus builder, R reference scripts, expected values and tolerances are unchanged. The final release run on 2026-10-22 passed 410/410 checks; 26/26 analyses agree; 2/2 refusals matched; 48/48 numbers reproduced: ALL PASS. Corpus: 13 datasets, 364 studies, 506 contrasts; 24 analyses fitted and 2 refused. UI smoke: 5/5 passed, with archived R corpus replay 410/410. The redacted log is provenance/run_plan-2026-10-22-release.log. The Windows runner used --allow-version-mismatch; all deviations are recorded in RECUT_NOTES.md and the original pins are unchanged. No numerical plus suite exists for NMA. Adds a separate browser usability smoke contract and byte-level source/integrity manifests. Simulated P(best) is excluded from the paper's validated claims. The optional browser R widget uses netmeta 3.4-0; it does not replace the archive's netmeta 3.7-0 benchmark. Includes portable Windows run instructions; retains original authorship and historical evidence.
